fusions.name: Hull Cracker
fusions.desc: A crushing bite that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Levelling Swing
fusions.desc: Sweeps every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage, each with a 30% chance of [Leaden] for 4 seconds, making blows harder to slip.

fusions.name: Anchor Mass
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 12 seconds and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rebound
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
